g.title: J
g.text: Warehouse: pick permitted quantity / remainder open

g.title: L
g.text: Warehouse: enter stock movement and email Finance

g.title: M
g.text: Finance waits for handoff and creates invoice

g.title: R
g.text: Finance: partial or unmatched balance review

g.title: U
g.text: Sales checks dependencies and stops demand

g.title: V
g.text: Finance / Warehouse: return or reversal review
